label: Inertial rival: some body is being moved in a respect of uniform rectilinear MOTION_1 while nothing…
paraphrase: Inertial rival (unattributed): some body is being moved in a respect of uniform rectilinear motion while nothing moves it in that respect. Newton's first law (STMT-NEWTON-LEX-I-CHANGE-OF-STATE-ONLY-BY-IMPRESSED-FORCE) motivates it but does not state it: the rival adds that some moving body is free of impressed force and that a state of uniform motion is a being moved. Result INERTIAL-OBJECTION-YIELDS-RIVAL derives it from the inertial objection's bundle with STMT-NOTHING-MOVES-ITSELF-IN-SAME-RESPECT, on the becoming reading of DISAMB-UNIFORM-MOTION-STATE-OR-BECOMING.
